# Chris Jenkins – Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate – Native American Group

> Chris Jenkins is a full-time REALTOR® serving Chesapeake, Virginia Beach, Norfolk and all of Hampton Roads, Virginia. Over $100M in sales, 500+ homes sold, HRRA Circle of Excellence 2013–present. Specializes in home buyers, home sellers and military PCS relocation. Phone (757) 286-7255.
